name: Open Y Programs Search
description: Provides a Block to search programs.
project_description: Open Y Programs Search (machine name openy_programs_search) is part of the Open Y / YMCA distribution. It provides a configurable, multi-step 'Programs Search' block that lets site visitors drill down through locations, categories/schools, programs, rate options and sessions and then hands them a deep link to register on the branch's Daxko registration system. Data is retrieved from Daxko through the sibling daxko API client and by scraping Daxko HTML pages with Symfony DomCrawler, then cached in a dedicated cache bin and periodically warmed via an Open Y cron service. An admin settings form configures the Daxko client ID, domain, base URL and the various Daxko URL path templates, plus location-name find/replace, excluded locations and pinned-program weighting used to map childcare programs to branches.
